bio.text: Dillan Vancil, an owner of a chain of coffee shops from Monmouth, won the Republican primary for Illinois' 17th Congressional District on March 17, 2026.
His WTTW voter guide entry lists his occupation as self-employed and his political experience as West-Central School Board member, 2021-2025.

sources.title: Dillan Vancil wins GOP primary to face Rep. Eric Sorensen in general election
